$comment: Curated Bengaluru park/neighbourhood-walk data for Baahar.
Coordinates are approximate centroids of the walkable green area, good to
~100 m, and were chosen to keep distance-from-user honest at city scale.
Baahar deliberately does NOT claim exact gate timings or crowd levels: those
change and would rot. `gate_note` is a nudge to check locally, not a claim.
Attribution: park extents and footpaths informed by OpenStreetMap
(c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Vibe text is original.

parks.name: Cubbon Park
parks.vibe: Canopy first. Old rain trees, a lot of shade, and the walking crowd that makes 6am feel safe.
parks.crowding_hint: High early morning and Sunday evening; quietest weekdays 07:00-09:00.
parks.gate_note: Multiple gates; several close around sunset. Check locally before a late walk.

parks.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
parks.vibe: Glasshouse, lake, and an absurd density of labelled trees. Best when you want one specific thing to look at.
parks.water_feature: Lalbagh Lake, with a wooden bridge
parks.crowding_hint: Very busy on weekends and holidays; weekday mornings are calm.
parks.gate_note: Ticketed entry on the main gate. Verify current hours and ticket rules before travelling.

parks.name: Bugle Rock Park
parks.vibe: A short climb to a rock outcrop with a view back over west Bengaluru. Small enough to actually finish.
parks.crowding_hint: Local evening crowd after 17:00; quiet at dawn.
parks.gate_note: Unfenced sides on the west - mind the drop. Morning hours vary by season.

parks.name: Ulsoor Lake
parks.vibe: Flat, paved, lamp-lit, and open late. The reliable choice when you just need to move for twenty minutes.
parks.crowding_hint: Joggers and walkers all evening; families on weekends.
parks.gate_note: Known for early-morning and late-night upkeep closures in parts of the perimeter. Verify locally.

parks.name: Sankey Lake
parks.vibe: A long uninterrupted loop around water with trees on one side and the city on the other. Great for thinking.
parks.crowding_hint: Calm most of the day, busy at sunset.
parks.gate_note: Public entry points at several road crossings.

parks.name: Kanteerava Outer Ring
parks.vibe: Not a park in the romantic sense - a stadium with a tree-lined ring road around it. Wide, lit, and predictable.
parks.gate_note: Outer ring is public road. Match closures around event days.

parks.name: Jnanabharathi Woods
parks.vibe: Less manicured, more birds and scrub. Fewer people, more mosquitoes after dark - so go in daylight.
parks.gate_note: University perimeter road. Be considerate - this is an active campus.

parks.name: Hesaraghatta Lake
parks.vibe: A real wild patch of north Bengaluru - migratory birds in season. Worth the drive.
parks.crowding_hint: Quiet on weekdays, family groups on weekends.
parks.gate_note: Long drive from the centre - treat as a half-day trip, not a pocket walk.

parks.name: Kadugodi Tree Park
parks.vibe: Dappled shade and a soft gravel loop. Good default for the west side of the city.

parks.name: Bagmane Lake, Whitefield
parks.vibe: Green and unexpectedly quiet inside a tech campus. East-side option when Cubbon feels far.
parks.gate_note: Campus access rules apply; verify entry from the main gate.

parks.name: Corporation Park, Jayanagar
parks.vibe: The classic Jayanagar neighbourhood park: a loop, a gym area, and kids everywhere. Very good for a genuinely short walk.
parks.gate_note: Public park; closes overnight. Verify current local rules.

parks.name: Venkatagiri Park, Jayanagar
parks.vibe: Two giant rain trees and a playground. The smallest useful green in the pack.
parks.gate_note: Public park; verify current local rules.
